# Test fixture: a pump replacement job pack

Not a shipped pack. The API tests lay this folder out as `packs/capital-projects/pump-replacement/` in a temporary repository root, so they can exercise what any job pack may carry: role briefs, a role tools file with a network line, a family pre-check and a role's own pre-check, and templates, typicals and examples shipped to the agent under `inputs/pack/`.
